threshold_procedure: Floors must retain every observed violation while every good control remains an explicit pass. wrapper-without-value uses 0.93, above its initial false-positive confidence 0.70 and below its refined positive minimum 0.99. invariant-helper uses its lowest positive confidence 0.55. These choices do not estimate production precision.
limitations: Small seed corpus; no held-out performance or production false-positive rate claimed. invariant-helper retired because its forwarding defect and controls duplicate wrapper-without-value. Historical two-rule rounds and thresholds are retained as observed, not active policy.
